summary: Clearwater TPA lookout with a 1934 steel tower, dismantled in 1955 or 1957; a 2022 visit report found only cement footings on the logged site.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in the 1950s and moved; the sources give 1955 or 1957. A 2022 visit report found only cement footings at the logged site.

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site in a 2022 visit report.

notes_for_editor: Removal year conflict: 1955 (association's 1955-56 report, via Forest Lookouts) against 1957 (Idaho Fire Lookouts, page dated October 21, 2022); both are shown in events and the story. The visit date itself is not stated; 2022 is the page's date. firelookout.com's 'R.I.P. 1923-1931' does not match the 1934 steel tower; those years match the first platform and pole tower, but no source explains the label. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says no documented staffing history, so none is given. No source read says who owns the summit today or what access rules apply. Record elevation_m is null; the 2022 page gives 4265 ft (about 1,300 m), which the editor may add to the record. Record design is null; no source gives a design letter for the 1934 steel tower.
